subject: AWS offer preflight: launch playbook + hero copy proposals
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@databeam.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@databeam.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell prep: next steps

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and cloud teams want to move forward with an AWS Marketplace listing and co-sell enablement. Before we loop Legal, Procurement asked for a short preflight checklist and a draft of the product page hero copy so they can start internal alignment. Can your team share a checklist of required artifacts (images, SKU guidance, pricing matrix, entitlements) and 2–3 hero copy options we can review?

We'd ideally have those by COB Wednesday (11/4) to keep timelines tight.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
DataBeam Ltd
Attachments: none

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@databeam.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell prep: next steps

Lisa — thanks, excited to get this moving.

Quick plan:
- I attached our "offer-preflight-checklist.xlsx" with required artifacts and recommended naming conventions.
- Kimberly, can you draft 2 hero copy options and one short subheadline focused on "time-to-value" vs "cost savings"?
- Karthik, can you prepare a short note on SKU/usage-tier recommendations and whether a privateoffer or SaaS contract is the better default?
- Jonas, please include a single-paragraph co-sell pitch we can feed to AWS partner ops (one-liner + top 3 value props).

Lisa — I put proposed delivery for the internal drafts by EOD Tuesday so we can iterate and send your team a consolidated pack by Wednesday morning. If procurement needs an MSA redline or SOC evidence, flag and we'll prioritize.

Talk soon,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Partnerships & Marketplace
Redwood Inference
Attachments: offer-preflight-checklist.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell prep: next steps

Team — attaching hero copy drafts and an image guidance PDF (simple stubs while design finalizes). Kept three short options with tone variations so DataBeam can pick one that matches their buyer POV.

Hero copy drafts (in attached hero_copy_v1.docx):
1) Option A — "LLM inference, production-grade: predictable latency and cost at scale."
   Subline — "Run open and custom models—fast, reliable, and cloud-ready."

2) Option B — "Ship AI features without the ops: high-throughput inference for teams."
   Subline — "Dedicated capacity, private options, and integrated cost controls."

3) Option C — "Cut inference costs. Keep quality. Scale confidently."
   Subline — "Unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."

Notes:
- Kept copy under 85 chars for hero placements.
- Included micro-CTAs for trials and private offers.
- Attached aws-listing-image-guidelines.pdf with recommended hero image ratios and allowable logos.

If you want more aggressive claims around specific latency numbers we need product sign-off; otherwise the qualitative promises above are safer for compliance.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: hero_copy_v1.docx, aws-listing-image-guidelines.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell prep: next steps

Quick SKU/pricing note — copying the checklist into the thread:
- Recommend 2 SKUs: "standard" (shared hosted) and "dedicated" (reserved capacity).
- Usage metric: tokens-in/tokens-out for hosted; vGPU-hours for dedicated.
- Pricing footnote: list base per-token and a committed vGPU hourly rate; call out burst pricing if enabled.
- PrivateOffer: advise enabling for initial enterprise customers for predictable billing and to close deals faster.

Also: for co-sell, AWS partner ops prefers a short one-paragraph solution summary plus three customer use cases. Jonas, your co-sell pitch will cover that.

Karthik
Head of Platform GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Lisa Chen <lisa@databeam.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@databeam.ai, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell prep: next steps

Sean / Kimberly / Karthik — thank you, this is great and very aligned with what our procurement asked for. The checklist looks complete and the hero copy Option B resonates best with our product marketing. A couple of small asks before we route to internal legal:
- Can you replace the phrase "without the ops" in Option B with "with zero ops friction" (legal prefers more formal language)?
- Please confirm the SKU names (standard/dedicated) are final in the checklist so our billing team can map them to our product catalog.

If you can send the updated doc and a single-page co-sell blurb, we'll schedule a procurement sync for Thursday morning.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
DataBeam Ltd
Attachments: none
